key_concepts: Weather can change from day to day.
Weather elements include temperature, clouds, sun, wind, and precipitation.
Weather instruments are used to measure weather elements.
Extreme weather means weather conditions outside normal patterns.
A typhoon is a storm with high winds and heavy rain that starts over warm ocean waters.
A tornado is a fast-spinning column of air from a thunderstorm cloud to Earth's surface.
A blizzard is a storm with blowing snow, high winds, and cold temperatures.
Flooding happens when too much rain makes streams, rivers, and lakes overflow.
